scope: Qualified TableSpec declared Cardinality classification, explicit native carrier projection and retained native/ideal recovery

regression.scope: All tests/core, tests/core-ideals, tests/postgresql, tests/sqlserver, tests/tablespec, tests/avro and tests/parquet test files except field-conformance.test.ts and nullability-conformance.test.ts, both run separately after evidence refresh.

criteria.AC1: Classification and projection tests cover positive/refusal/approximation/unknown cases and both retained recovery directions
criteria.AC2: Combined native entrypoint reruns pinned model/schema/generator checks and source fingerprints, including dimension/null-item disagreement and float narrowing
criteria.AC3: Combined real Chromium entrypoint passes classification/projection parity and recoveries without host globals or external requests; typecheck passes
criteria.AC4: All schemas audited; nested/cyclic/record/unknown item definitions, absent item meaning and scalar-container boundaries have explicit tests

limits: One qualified binding does not admit the Cardinality ideal or complete all-five delivery; PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Avro and Parquet remain pending.
Declared column shape is not whole-native-model validation, item typing or execution equivalence.
Vector dimension, numeric precision, item availability and nested/unknown definitions retain explicit residuals. Strict mode refuses; retained receipts recover author meaning.
Map or incompatible-shape report candidates are carrier-only, not JSON/text encodings, child-table layouts or implemented row conversions.
No complete TableSpec pipeline, GX or generated SQL execution claim. Native vector execution checks use dimension three and named synthetic cases.
The regression scope is core and the five priority systems, not the full repository. Original acceptance records retain historical counts alongside current revalidation.

revalidation.reason: TD-042 adds PostgreSQL native discovery requirements; existing core/TableSpec implementation and schemas are unchanged
revalidation.note: Documentation-only refresh. PostgreSQL Cardinality binding and ideal admission remain unfinished.
